REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 7, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 867 9200 9347
COMMISSION MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Community Development Department counter, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Debvelopment Department counter during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86792009347
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 867 9200 9347
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 77-50(2021) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY THE PROPERTY OWNER, HAITAI, LLC, TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST- AND SECOND-FLOOR OFFICE ADDITION AND AN INTERIOR REMODEL TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY INDUSTRIAL BUILDING AT 13151 MIDWAY PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE PROPOSED IMPROVEMENTS ALSO INCLUDE REFURBISHMENT OF THE EXISTING LANDSCAPING AND OTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7005-005-083).*
*Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 22: PRESENTATION PACKET
6B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2008-3(2021) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT SBA MONARCH TOWERS I, LLC, ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WEST CORPORATION, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, THREE (3) REMOTE RADIO UNITS AND THREE (3) TOWER-MOUNTED AMPLIFIERS MOUNTED ON THE MONOPINE STRUCTURE. AN EXISTING GROUND-LEVEL EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE IS LOCATED WITHIN THE SUBJECT FACILITY THAT CONTAINS ONE (1) EQUIPMENT CABINET AND OTHER SUPPORT EQUIPMENT FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. THE APPLICANT WILL RE-BRANCH THE MONOPINE STRUCTURE AS PART OF THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT MONOPINE WIRELESS FACILITY IS LOCATED AT 11120 BUSINESS CIRCLE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED INDUSTRIAL/COMMERCIAL (MC) (APN 7034-016-029).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 18: PRESENTATION PACKET
6C.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2004-1(2021) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT TECTONIC ENGINEERING, ON BEHALF OF VERIZON WIRELESS, TO RENEW AN EXISTING BUILDING-MOUNTED WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON A COMMERCIAL PROPERTY. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, SIX (6) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, AND SIX (6) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS AND OTHER SUPPORT EQUIPMENT FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICAITON PURPOSES. THE SUBJECT WIRELESS FACLITY ANTENNAS AND SUPPORT EQUIPMENT ARE LOCATED BEHIND AN EXISTING SCREEN ON THE ROOFTOP OF A TWO-STORY COMMERCIAL BUILDING. NO CHANGES TO THE EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ARE PROPOSED WITH THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT WIRELESS FACILITY IS LOCATED AT 11829 SOUTH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED COMMUNITY COMMERCIAL (CC) (APN 7040-024-019).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 20: PRESENTATION PACKET
7.
New and Old Business
7A.
Review and comment by the Cerritos Planning Commission on an administrative approval of a Minor Precise Plan proposal by Norm Reeves Hyundai Superstore Cerritos for an exterior remodel of the existing automobile dealership building and related landscape improvements. The subject property is located at 10901 183rd Street, Cerritos, California, 90703 and is zoned Development Area Five (ADP-5) (APN 7034-017-030).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

8A.

8B.
Reports from Cerritos Planning Commissioners
During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Brown Act, there will be no discussion or action taken on any of the matters that may be presented during this agenda item.
9.
